definitions.normal_clients: IDs excluding configured attackers for all rounds, including pre-attack rounds
definitions.normal_mean_exclusion: fully excluded honest client-rounds / all honest client-rounds
definitions.normal_ever_excluded_rate: unique honest clients fully excluded at least once / honest clients
definitions.exclusion_delay_rounds: first post-start round with zero included layers minus attack start; not a SUSPECT detection delay
definitions.pre_attack_exclusion: reported separately; cannot attribute pre-existing exclusion to attack detection
definitions.recovery: not measured: these runs do not stop the attack
definitions.baseline_audit: n/a means per-client layer eligibility is unavailable, not zero exclusion
definitions.scope: two development seeds; descriptive sample mean and SD, not significance or final paper evidence
